updates.title: HRT labs not required for pilot program patients
updates.body:
-HRT Labs not required for specific patients

We have successfully been seeing New York HRT patients with no labs for several weeks now. We are going to broaden the pilot program to several other patients in different states.

Please ALWAYS first check to see if a lab order was generated.

If no lab order was generated, that means they are part of our no labs pilot program. Please do not offer labs to these patients.

updates.body:
🟢 LABS UPDATES

-Lab links during Holiday

Lab scheduling is rarely successful on major holidays and for this reason Lab bookings will be prevented on those days. This will hopefully help reduce the influx of error reports we get for lab booking on our major Holiday's.

If a patient is having an issue with the lab scheduling link during a major holiday please prompt the patient to try again after.

If the issue persists after the holiday, the patient should notify us.

updates.title: Lab scheduling link issue
updates.body:
-Lab scheduling link issues

When issues occur for lab scheduling please do the following:

Verify lab scheduling is not working on our end and not just the patients

If it is not working, then this indicates the issue is not specific to the patient, and tech should be notified.

Please send message to Tech_CS channel.

Send message to the patient letting them know our tech has been notified.

Snooze ticket to follow up on the matter next day.

If Tech has not provided any updates attempt to utilize the link.

If it works please notify the patient to proceed.

If it does not work continue to snooze until tech provides an update or we see resolution on our end.

updates.title: Our lab scheduling fix
updates.body:
Hi @channel we had an error occur with our lab scheduling for patient's who completed their booking between the dates of 12/15/25- 1/2/26. The system replaced their legal name on the booking with "Testy Mr Tester". However, the lab order has the correct legal name. Many patient's have still been able to proceed with their lab appointment despite this hiccup.

If anyone reaches out and states the lab is unable to locate their name/booking or their booking is under "Testy Mr Tester" please send the following macro. If any escalations occur regarding this matter please defer to the shift supervisor team.

Title: Testy Mr Tester Lab Booking error causing lab to not be able to find the patient booking Appointment bookings were made between 12/15-1/2

"Hi there, we recently experienced a technical issue that caused our system to override the patient's name while booking their lab appointment. This issue has since been resolved, and should not affect future bookings.

If you would still like to proceed with your lab draw you may provide the lab with this requisition/confirmation number listed on the lab order:

The lab should still be able to proceed with your lab draw with the valid lab order as it list the correct patient information. If needed we can also send you a secure email with a copy of your lab order.

If you prefer to reschedule your lab draw please let us know here, and we will send you the lab scheduling link:

Please let us know here if we can be of any further assistance to you. Have a great day!"

updates.title: Process update
updates.body:
-Failed Payments caught up

If we see a case where a payment fails for one month and the patient makes a payment to their next subscription charge date when it arrives, they still end up with a failed payment tied to the new charge.Typically the system does not prompt any services while their subscription is inactive from failed payments. Due to this, the new charge should be voided or the charge date should be delayed.Please send these cases to the SS for review/action to void payment or delay the charge date.Remember to also create the refills and clarifications ticket for the pharmacy team to monitor any refills that may have been missed due to nonpayment.

updates.title: Requests routed to shift supervisor
updates.body:
-Charge cost of labs if outside of a subscription

In the following two scenarios we will manually charge the patient a $35 fee for lab work. (Additional charges would apply if the patient chose to schedule at LabCorp or have any expanded panels tested.)

If a patient meets with a provider and it is determined that they need to have labs redone to reevaluate if they are a candidate for HRT/TRT (prior to them setting up a subscription), we will need to charge the $35 fee for the additional lab draw prior to scheduling.

When a patient cancels their subscription and wants to complete a follow up visit with the provider to determine if they want to continue treatment. If the provider then recommends labs before the patient decides they'd like to continue with a subscription, they will need to be charged the $35 lab fee prior to scheduling.

CS will send these scenarios to the Shift Supervisor team for review/approval.

Once confirmed that the patient qualifies for the lab work outside of a subscription, it will be sent back to CS to process charge and provide the scheduling link to the patient.

updates.title: Requests routed to shift supervisor
updates.body:
-Cancellation Reasons

We are adjusting our cancellation workflow. When a patient states that they would like to cancel, CS please send the macro titled:

"Our team has received your cancellation request. Before we make the appropriate adjustments to your account please share if any particular reason contributed to your decision to cancel your subscription. We would like to see if there is any way we can provide a more suitable experience for you. We appreciate your feedback as this will also help our team improve future patient experience."

Once the patient responds with their reason for cancellation, CS should send it to the Shift Supervisor team.

CS does not need to process cancellation in stripe. Once reason for cancellation request has been provided by the patient, send the matter to Shift Supervisor team. They will proceed with cancellation if appropriate.

Remember if a patient states they would like a refund, please specify that a refund was requested.

"Hi there, welcome to Fountain – glad to have you here! The next step is scheduling your lab appointment. What times/dates would be good for you to go into a nearby lab for a blood test?"

This was sent in error. Labs were not included at check out for these patient's as previously discussed. Rob has fixed this system error. Please send the following macro to these patient's with their VV scheduling link. Thanks!

Title: System Error causing lab scheduling message to send to HRT sign ups after 1/21/26

"Hi there, we apologize for the confusion—our system sent the previous message regarding lab scheduling in error.At this time, the next step is to schedule your initial video visit with one of our providers. If you haven’t already done so, please use the link below to book your appointment:[Insert scheduling link]We look forward to speaking with you soon!"

updates.title: Third-party patient confirmation prohibited
updates.body:
-3rd party communication for translation

As advised previously on these matters, if a family member attempts to reach out regarding the patient we SHOULD NOT confirm/deny if the mentioned patient is our patient.

We are unable to communicate with anyone other than the patient for HIPAA compliance.

We should ONLY respond directly to the number we have on file for the patient in all scenarios letting them know who reached out/answers to questions.

If the patient needs a translator for the visit, the patient can message us about needing a translator for a visit once we get to that point.

If patient needs translation of info sent via message this is up to the patients discretion
